```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins <- penguins
view(penguins)
```

## Row 1

```{r, warning=FALSE}

ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_boxplot()

```

```{r, warning=FALSE}

ggplot(penguins, aes(island, bill_length_mm)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```
